<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="y8p-GQ6z6ft1YbIDzbrh"> <mxGraphModel dx="1935" dy="1360" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor Client
 participant PC as PaymentController
 participant PO as PaymentOrchestrator
 participant IV as InvoiceValidation
 participant INV as InventoryService
 participant PSF as PaymentServiceFactory
 participant PS as PaymentService<br/>(Cash / Razorpay)
 participant Repo as Payment/InvoiceRepository

 Client->>PC: PaymentRequest{invoiceId, paymentMethod}
 PC->>PO: processInvoicePayment(request)
 PO->>Repo: findByInvoiceId(invoiceId)
 PO->>IV: validateCanPay(invoice)
 PO->>INV: validate(product, qty) per invoice item
 PO->>Repo: getOrCreatePendingPayment(invoice, request)
 PO->>PSF: getPaymentService(paymentMethod)
 PSF-->>PO: PaymentService impl
 PO->>PS: pay(payment)
 alt CASH
 PS-->>PO: payment marked SUCCESS
 else ONLINE (Razorpay)
 PS-->>PO: payment with gatewayOrderId (PENDING)
 end
 PO->>PO: handlePaymentResult()
 alt paymentStatus == SUCCESS
 PO->>Repo: invoice.markPaid()
 PO->>INV: deductStock(product, qty) per item
 end
 PO-->>PC: PaymentResponse
 PC-->>Client: 200 OK",
 "config": null
